title: Database Traffic Controller
subtitle: Keeps heavy bulk writes from flattening the database: it prices each write by its expected load, lets cheap work through, holds heavy work until there is room, and tunes the write workers.
lede: Keeps heavy bulk writes from flattening the database: it prices each write by its expected load, lets cheap work through, holds heavy work until there is room, and tunes the write workers. You can run it in watch-only mode first and switch to enforcing when you trust the numbers.
author: Corey James
